intentional_breaks.change: Managed `concurrent = [...]` tasks now require `mode = "tui"`, and container-lifecycle sidecars belong on `[[containers.<name>.host_processes]]` instead of hanging off non-TUI concurrent tasks.
intentional_breaks.migration_note: Add `mode = "tui"` to managed concurrent tasks that use `concurrent = [...]`, and move lifecycle-owned sidecars onto `[[containers.<name>.host_processes]]`.

intentional_breaks.change: Legacy root deferral is no longer inferred from `composer.json` or `effigy.json`.
intentional_breaks.migration_note: Add an explicit `[defer]` block or adopt a shipped bundle that provides one if the repo still relies on root-level fallback execution.

intentional_breaks.surface: workspace and managed task config contract
intentional_breaks.change: Workspace/container defaults moved onto `[systems.<name>]`, managed task settings moved directly onto `[tasks.<name>]`, generated compose output moved under `.effigy/runtime/compose`, and task-level `host = true` was replaced by `run_in = "host" | "container" | "either"`.
intentional_breaks.migration_note: Move workspace config onto `[systems.<name>]`, flatten managed task settings onto `[tasks.<name>]`, stop reading generated compose from the old location, and replace `host = true` with `run_in`.

intentional_breaks.change: Removed compatibility-only shell entrypoints for release checks, release smoke, install-link setup, install-from-tag verification, and release prepare flow.
intentional_breaks.migration_note: Call the native Effigy surfaces directly instead: `effigy release gates`, `effigy release verify-install`, `effigy smoke:release`, `effigy bootstrap:local`, and `effigy release prepare` / `effigy release prepare --plan`.
